text:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — vendor pushed the H100 shipment. Rack reservation for Dedicated pool C moved from 2024-04-10 to 2024-04-18. This impacts the Canary week we planned. Need a fallback plan for canary deploys and clear ownership for acceptance criteria. @raj @ben

Raj: Which reservations exactly are affected? I thought we had buffer in pool B.

Ben: Pool B has 4 racks but they're pinned for enterprise trials next week. Pool C is the one delayed; borrowing B would impact those trials.

Maria: For context — our canary needs to sustain ~200 QPS with ~5k token avg to validate latency/cost regressions. If we shrink canary traffic we might miss perf regressions.

Priya: I can own the fallback plan. Proposal: run a reduced canary on pool B with traffic shaping (50% of original) + perf flags enabled, and a parallel smaller functional canary against pool A for quality checks. Will coordinate SRE and Security.

Dan: Ping me for the infra CR review. I have PR #4321 that adds traffic-shaper + fallback routing rules. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321 PTAL.

security-bot: Reminder — Private KMS rotation scheduled 2024-04-15. If fallback changes route to Private VPC, role bindings and key policies must be verified before the canary.

Raj: I'll sync with Security on the KMS rotation and confirm whether we need a key exemption window. Also checking cache node burst capacity for the reduced canary.

Ben: Sharing proposed routing snippet (still WIP):
```yaml
fallback_policy: manual
borrow_pool: pool-b
traffic_shaper:
  target_pct: 50
  decay: 10m
```
Please review before I push to staging.

Olivia: Can we get SRE + Security signoff by EOD Friday? If not, we should postpone the canary by one week. @deploy-bot please check schedule conflicts.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule check complete — current window 2024-04-12 02:00-06:00 UTC. Pending approvals: SRE, Security, Ownership (Priya).

Maria: If we reduce traffic I'll add a compact eval set focused on latency-sensitive prompts so we still catch quality regressions.

Priya: I'll own the signoffs. I'll draft a 1-pager with acceptance criteria + owner checklist and post link here by tomorrow morning.

Dan: I'll queue the infra PR for review and add `@olivia` and `@priya` as reviewers. Also adding a simple smoke test to the pipeline.

Olivia: Thanks everyone. Let's try to keep this async — Priya, drop the doc here and I'll confirm signoff once SRE/Security ack. :thumbsup:
